[Intro 1]
[C5]

[Intro 2]
[C5]

[Verse 1]
[C5]Eyes tied tight for-
ever
Mouth wired shut for-
ever
Body parts dis-
sever
You will see no
more
Never....

[Intrelude]
[C5]

[Verse 2]
[C5]Lowered into
the ground
You will never hear a-
nother sound
In your coffin you
are bound
Underground
Fore

[Bridge]
[A#5]ver

[Verse 3]
[A#5]To the [C5]earth you're
[E5]now [C5]enslaved,
[A#5]To the [C5]creatures
[E5]long [C5]depraved
[A#5]Flesh has [C5]now
[E5]turned to [C5]grey,
[A#5]As the [C5]larve
[E5]gnaw [C5]away

[Intrelude]
[A#5]

[Verse 4]
[A#5]As you [C5]rot in
[E5]your smallish [C5]tomb,
[A#5]Insects care [C5]not how you
[E5]met your [C5]doom
[A#5]In your [C5]casket e-
[E5]ternally [C5]lie.
[A#5]Many were [C5]pleased to
[E5]see you [C5]

[Intrelude]
[A#5]die

[Bridge]
[A#5]

[Chorus]
[A#5]Fester
In the
Crypt where
You lie

[Solo]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[C5]  [B5]
[B5]  [A#5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]
[A#5]  [C5]  [C#5]  [C5]
[C5]  [B5]
[B5]  [A#5]

[Chorus]
[A#5]Victims
Pass by
They watched
You die

[Intrelude]
[C5]

[Verse 5]
[C5]Flesh melts off of
your frame.
Infamous was
your name
Years passed since you
moved on
Nothing left but
carry on

[Outro]
[C#5][C5][A#5]Festering [C5]in
[A#5]the [C5]crypt
title: Festering In The Crypt
